title: Two-character emotional loop
intent: High pressure standoff; enforcement should push earlier structural breaks than endless talk-only loops.
opening_description: They have circled the same argument three times in this corridor—accusation, denial, wounded silence, repeat. Voices are controlled but the space feels smaller each pass.
trigger_text: Celina exhales through her teeth. 'We are not doing this again.' Ayame doesn't move from the doorway.

seed_issue.description: Same emotional loop without resolution; each wants the other to yield first.
